content: GitHub Actions upload-artifact@v6 (actions/upload-artifact) supports uploading multiple named artifacts from the same workflow. Two separate 'Upload artifact' steps with different 'name:' values produce separate named artifacts in the same workflow run. Existing artifact 'pkgdown-site-run_id' uploads docs/ directory. A new step with name 'pkgdown-visual-run_id' uploading test_output/pkgdown-visual/ is the correct pattern. Both steps can have if-no-files-found: warn or error. The browser-visual-smoke.yaml already demonstrates this exact pattern with upload-artifact@v6.
